authoring_basis: Hand-authored from all 15 public-source PNGs viewed 2026-10-25 and approved plan scope; not computed from runtime catalog or layout. Ordinal keys retain legacy demo identities only; synthetic handling and source branches are explicitly separated.

hr.03: Reduce heated slab in roughing stands
hr.04: Finish hot strip through successive rolling stands
hr.05: Cool strip on supported runout rollers
hr.06: Wind strip into hot rolled coil
hr.07: Finish and level hot rolled product

plate.05: Support and cool plate on cooling bed

wire.08: Lay wire rings and cool on supported conveyor

gi.05: Hot dip coat cold rolled strip with zinc

ga.06: Heat coated strip to form zinc iron alloy

hgi.02: Unwind hot rolled feed without mandatory cold reduction
hgi.03: Clean hot rolled feed for coating
hgi.04: Heat treat hot rolled coating feed with synthetic detailed line arrangement
hgi.05: Hot dip zinc coat hot rolled feed
hgi.07: Post treat coated hot rolled surface

go.10: Refine magnetic domains as a manufacturing treatment

sts-hr.10: Unwind stainless hot coil for HAPL
sts-hr.02: Melt stainless scrap in electric arc furnace

sts-cr.07: Tension level stainless strip in TLL

ti-hr.02: Forge purchased titanium ingot to slab

ti-cr.04: Recoil for vacuum annealing handling; synthetic handling segmentation
ti-cr.05: Vacuum anneal titanium coil in VAF
ti-cr.06: Reintroduce annealed coil into finishing; synthetic handling segmentation
ti-cr.07: Tension level titanium strip in TLL
ti-cr.08: Optional STL slit output to skelp; must not be compulsory for cold coil
ti-cr.09: Cold coil output from TLL branch; route correction required

ti-sheet.04: Recoil for VAF handling; synthetic handling segmentation
ti-sheet.06: Feed annealed material back to finishing; synthetic handling segmentation
ti-sheet.08: STL is alternate skelp branch; sheet route must not require STL
ti-sheet.09: Shear sheet in SHL after TLL branch

product_functions.slab: Carbon upstream to slab casting, cut/cool, sale or downstream feed
product_functions.bloom: Carbon upstream to bloom casting, cut/cool, sale or wire feed
product_functions.billet: Carbon upstream to billet casting, cut/cool, sale or downstream feed
product_functions.hr: Slab heating, roughing, finishing, cooling, coiling, conditioning; sale or downstream feed
product_functions.plate: Slab to rolled/cooled/cut/heat-treated/leveled plate with ultrasonic inspection
product_functions.wire: Bloom through billet rolling/conditioning, wire reheating/rolling/laying/cooling
product_functions.cr: HR feed through pickling/cold rolling/cleaning/annealing/temper/oiling/coiling; sale or downstream feed
product_functions.gi: CR feed through cleaning/annealing/zinc hot dip coating/post treatment/coiling
product_functions.ga: CR feed through zinc coating and zinc iron alloying heat treatment/post treatment/coiling
product_functions.hgi: HR feed through hot rolled galvanizing without compulsory cold rolling
product_functions.eg: CR feed through tension leveling/electroplating/phosphate/anti fingerprint/oven-cooler/coiling
product_functions.go: Electrical hot band through cold reduction/decarburization/high temperature anneal/flattening/insulation/domain refinement
product_functions.ngo: Non oriented electrical steel through cold reduction/annealing/insulation
product_functions.sts-hr: Scrap EAF/refining/casting/hot rolling/CAF/HAPL/coiling; sale or downstream feed
product_functions.sts-cr: Stainless hot rolled feed through cold rolling/CAPL/temper/TLL/STL/coiling
product_functions.sts-plate: Scrap EAF/refining/casting/plate rolling/hot leveling/cooling/cutting/cold leveling/heat treatment
product_functions.ti-hr: Purchased Ti ingot forging/heating/hot rolling/HAPL/coiling; no in-plant sponge/VAR/EBM
product_functions.ti-cr: Ti hot coil cold rolling/VAF/TLL to cold coil OR STL-skelp, with explicit alternative branches
product_functions.ti-sheet: Ti hot coil cold rolling/VAF/TLL to SHL-sheet without forcing the STL skelp branch

kind_functions.charge: Meter and charge tracked raw material
kind_functions.blast_furnace: Receive burden and tap hot metal
kind_functions.bof: Charge oxygen converter and tap steel
kind_functions.ladle_furnace: Refine steel with ladle support and electrodes
kind_functions.caster: Mold, guide and withdraw strand with section-specific support
kind_functions.shear: Cut supported material with the process-specific blade or torch
kind_functions.furnace: Charge, heat and discharge supported stock
kind_functions.roughing: Reduce stock in roughing roll stands
kind_functions.finishing_mill: Finish strip or plate through active roll stands
kind_functions.coiler: Grip and wind strip on rotating mandrel
kind_functions.leveler: Straighten or tension level supported material
kind_functions.cooling_bed: Support and move material while cooling
kind_functions.heat_treatment: Load, heat treat and unload material
kind_functions.laying_head: Form wire rings on cooling conveyor
kind_functions.pickling: Pass strip or plate through pickling treatment
kind_functions.cold_mill: Cold reduce strip with loaded rotating work rolls
kind_functions.annealing: Anneal with process-specific continuous or batch handling
kind_functions.oiling: Meter protective oil to moving material
kind_functions.galvanizing: Immerse strip in molten zinc coating bath
kind_functions.coating: Apply specified surface or insulation coating
kind_functions.alloying: Heat zinc coated strip for zinc iron alloy formation
kind_functions.electroplating: Deposit zinc using electrode cell interaction
kind_functions.inspection: Execute specified quality inspection; never replace domain refinement
kind_functions.vacuum_annealing: Load coil, close vessel, vacuum anneal, unload
kind_functions.packaging: Bind, protect and identify finished material
kind_functions.stock: Store material with exclusive supported custody
kind_functions.port: Stage and transfer cargo at operational berth
kind_functions.ship: Persist as vessel through berth, load, voyage and unload
kind_functions.delivery: Unload and transfer material into customer custody

source_review_corrections.basis: Independent source findings S1/S2/S3, confirmed by direct original-resolution viewing of all seven affected local images on 2026-10-25. Exact positions below are visual process requirements, not existing implementation observations.

requirements.section: middle row, right-to-left; yellow base-coating applicator after decarburization exit looper
requirements.function: Apply GO base coating after decarburization annealing and before high-temperature annealing; distinct from final electrical insulation coating after flattening anneal. Coating chemistry is unspecified.
requirements.branch: GO: src:go-06 decarburization -> exit looper -> base coating -> src:go-basecoat-output-cutter -> intermediate coil -> src:go-07 high-temperature annealing; not src:go-09 insulation coating
requirements.motion: Strip moves through active base-coating applicator with supported rolls; coating application state and downstream coil handoff remain observable.

requirements.section: upper row right end, after cold rolling stands and before intermediate coiling
requirements.function: Cut/separate cold-rolled strip at the cold-mill section output before intermediate coil handling; distinct from final finishing output cut.
requirements.branch: CR: src:cr-04 cold rolling -> section-output cutter -> intermediate coil -> electrocleaning/annealing section
requirements.motion: Supported strip feed stops or synchronizes with blade cut/separate stroke, then separated strip end transfers to coiling support.

requirements.section: bottom row, after oiling and before finished coiling/packaging
requirements.function: Cut/separate finished cold-rolled strip after oiling and before final coil formation/packaging.
requirements.branch: CR: src:cr-08 oiling -> finished-output cutter -> src:cr-09 finished coil -> packaging
requirements.motion: Supported finished strip passes controlled feed and blade cut/separate stroke before coil handoff.

requirements.section: upper row right end, after pickling exit looper and before intermediate coil/cold rolling
requirements.function: Cut/separate GO strip at the annealing/pickling continuous-section output before cold rolling feed.
requirements.branch: GO: src:go-04 pickling -> exit looper -> pickling-output cutter -> intermediate coil -> src:go-05 cold rolling
requirements.motion: Looper-fed strip remains supported during cutter stroke and separated-end transfer to intermediate coiling.

requirements.section: middle row left end, after base coating and before intermediate coils/high-temperature annealing
requirements.function: Cut/separate base-coated GO strip at the decarburization/base-coating section output before batch coil annealing.
requirements.branch: GO: src:go-base-coating -> basecoat-output cutter -> intermediate coil -> src:go-07 high-temperature annealing
requirements.motion: Base-coated supported strip receives a distinct cutter stroke and coil handoff before batch annealing loading.

requirements.section: bottom row right, after insulation and domain refinement and before finished coil
requirements.function: Cut/separate finished GO strip after domain refinement before final coiling; do not substitute magnetic-domain treatment for cutting.
requirements.branch: GO: src:go-08 flattening anneal -> src:go-09 insulation coating -> src:go-domain-refinement -> finished-output cutter -> src:go-11 coil
requirements.motion: Supported finished strip is cut by a controlled blade stroke and handed to final coiling support.

requirements.section: upper row right, after pickling exit looper and before intermediate coil/cold rolling
requirements.function: Cut/separate NGO strip at the pre-anneal/pickling section output before cold rolling feed.
requirements.branch: NGO: src:ngo-04 pickling -> exit looper -> pickling-output cutter -> intermediate coil -> src:ngo-05 cold rolling
requirements.motion: Looper-fed supported strip receives a cutter stroke with explicit separated-end transfer to intermediate coiling.

requirements.section: bottom row left, after final anneal/insulation/drying return and before finished coils
requirements.function: Cut/separate finished NGO strip after insulation-coating drying and before final coiling.
requirements.branch: NGO: src:ngo-06 final anneal -> src:ngo-07 insulation coating -> src:ngo-drying -> finished-output cutter -> src:ngo-08 coil
requirements.motion: Dried coated strip stays supported through feed, blade cut/separate stroke and final coil handoff.

requirements.section: bottom row left, after HAPL pickling exit looper and before product coiler
requirements.function: Cut/separate stainless hot strip at the HAPL continuous-section output before coiling; preserve this end cut separately from cold-line STL longitudinal slitting.
requirements.branch: STS-HR: src:sts-hr-12 HAPL pickling -> exit looper -> HAPL output cutter -> src:sts-hr-13 product coil
requirements.motion: HAPL exit strip advances on support through cutter stroke and separated-end coiler handoff.

requirements.section: middle row right, after CAPL pickling exit looper and before coil handling/next temper section
requirements.function: Cut/separate stainless cold strip at the CAPL section output; this transverse end cut is distinct from downstream STL longitudinal skelp slitting.
requirements.branch: STS-CR: src:sts-cr-05 CAPL pickling -> exit looper -> CAPL output cutter -> intermediate coil -> src:sts-cr-06 temper -> TLL -> STL
requirements.motion: CAPL exit strip is supported during cutter stroke and coil handoff; separate later STL knives and slitting motion remain required.

requirements.section: bottom row, after oiling and before finished coil/packaging
requirements.function: Cut/separate finished hot-dip coated strip at the GI and GA line outputs after oiling and before final coiling.
requirements.branch: GI: src:gi-08 oiling -> output cutter -> src:gi-09 coil; GA: src:ga-09 oiling -> output cutter -> src:ga-10 coil
requirements.motion: Coated strip remains supported while a controlled blade stroke separates the strip end for coiler transfer; verify GI and GA placements individually.

requirements.section: shared hot-dip bottom-row output cutter; HGI arrangement is an explicit adaptation
requirements.function: For the HGI shared-line design, cut/separate hot-rolled coated strip after oiling and before final coiling without mandatory cold rolling.
requirements.branch: HGI synthetic shared-diagram adaptation: HR feed -> src:hgi-08 oiling -> output cutter -> src:hgi-09 coil
requirements.motion: Supported HGI strip receives cutter stroke and coiler transfer; HGI geometry/arrangement remains unverified.

requirements.section: bottom row, after oiling and before finished coil/packaging
requirements.function: Cut/separate finished electrogalvanized strip at the EG output after oiling and before final coiling; separate from oven/cooler function.
requirements.branch: EG: src:eg-08 oiling -> output cutter -> src:eg-09 coil -> packaging
requirements.motion: Supported electrogalvanized strip is fed through a blade cut/separate stroke and transferred to final coiling.

requirements.section: right turn upright cooling section after bath/Air Knife and before temper rolling
requirements.function: Cool hot-dip galvanized strip after the zinc bath and Air Knife before temper rolling; no compulsory GA alloying and no substitution by EG oven/cooler.
requirements.branch: GI: src:gi-05 zinc bath -> src:coating-air-knife -> coating cooling -> src:gi-06 temper rolling
requirements.motion: Strip advances through the dedicated cooling section on continuous support; cooling state and upstream/downstream handoffs are visible without invented coolant chemistry.

requirements.section: right turn upright cooling section after alloying treatment and before temper rolling
requirements.function: Cool galvannealed strip after zinc bath/Air Knife and alloying heat treatment, before temper rolling; preserve GA alloying-before-cooling order.
requirements.branch: GA: src:ga-05 zinc bath -> src:coating-air-knife -> src:ga-06 alloying -> coating cooling -> src:ga-07 temper rolling
requirements.motion: Supported strip progresses from alloying into the distinct cooling section and onward to temper; cooling activity and custody remain observable.

requirements.section: shared hot-dip right-turn cooling section; HGI-specific diagram not verified
requirements.function: Include post-bath/Air-Knife cooling before temper in the synthetic HGI shared-line arrangement while retaining HR feed and dedicated-diagram uncertainty.
requirements.branch: HGI synthetic shared-diagram adaptation: HR feed -> src:hgi-05 zinc bath -> src:coating-air-knife -> coating cooling -> src:hgi-06 temper
requirements.motion: Supported HGI strip traverses a stateful cooling section before temper; precise geometry, cooling mechanics and speed are synthetic pending design.
